description: This file defines the internal class WorkItemGroup within the Orleans runtime scheduler, managing task queues, execution, and scheduling for grain contexts.

classes.name: WorkItemGroup
classes.description: Manages a group of work items (tasks) associated with a grain context, handling queuing, execution, and scheduling within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: EnqueueTask
methods.description: Adds a task to the work item queue and schedules execution if the group was waiting.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Processes queued tasks, executing them in a single-threaded environment, and manages state transitions.

methods.name: DumpStatus
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current status of the work item group, including queued tasks and context details.

methods.name: QueueAction
methods.description: Queues an action to be executed by the task scheduler.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Starts a task using the group's task scheduler.
